global: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen features rich, dark broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. The white ceramic bowl sits on a wooden table, warmly lit, with subtle reflections dancing on the glossy surface.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle natural texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim with delicate painted edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth, dark brown, glossy, with visible green onion rings and faint noodle strands swirling beneath.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with uneven edges and visible surface wrinkles.
regions.meat: Chashu pork has caramelized, crispy brown crust over tender white meat with visible fat layers and slight char marks.
